powertoys.aggregationMeaning: Union/exclusive durations were computed inside each replay stream. Across distinct BuildHost streams, project service durations are added, never interpreted as union wall. Repeated project paths/TFM contexts remain path aggregates; every stream occurrence is retained.
powertoys.meaning: Evaluation and exclusive target/task layers reported separately; inclusive target/task parents are never added. Across streams, service durations are summed, not asserted to be wall. First-three ordering uses available one-stream appearance or explicitly labeled public callback proxy; otherwise unavailable. Synthetic aggregator/unmatched projects remain separate. Differences are diagnostic context effects, not causal process-start measurements.
